credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: The upper portion of a kokopelli figure is located just to the left of center in this work.  His black head is bisected by a white stripe along the forehead and down to the nose.  His eyes are white circles.  Brown, red, and black feathers protrude from the top of his head.
